mapper.sql: video_id, account_id, upload_id, object_key, video_url, original_filename, file_size, file_hash, upload_status, media_status, created_time, updated_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_assets (account_id, upload_id, object_key, video_url, original_filename, file_size, file_hash, upload_status, media_status, created_time, updated_time) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{uploadId}, #{objectKey}, #{videoUrl}, #{originalFileName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{uploadStatus}, #{mediaStatus}, #{createdTime}, #{updatedTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE video_assets SET upload_status = 'UPLOADING', media_status = 'PENDING', updated_time = #{updatedTime} WHERE video_id = #{videoId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE video_assets SET video_url = #{videoUrl}, upload_status = 'COMPLETED', updated_time = #{updatedTime} WHERE video_id = #{videoId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE video_assets SET upload_status = 'FAILED', updated_time = #{updatedTime} WHERE video_id = #{videoId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE video_assets SET file_hash = #{fileHash}, media_status = #{mediaStatus}, updated_time = #{updatedTime} WHERE video_id = #{videoId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
